blocks.raw: ## Configure call task expiry period
blocks.text: Configure call task expiry period

blocks.raw:
A store associate can see the task notification for the specified duration(days) from the message triggered to date. After the expiry period, the call task content will disappear from the destination app (InStore/Store2Door).\
You cannot have call task expiry beyond the campaign expiry date.
blocks.text: A store associate can see the task notification for the specified duration(days) from the message triggered to date. After the expiry period, the call task content will disappear from the destination app (InStore/Store2Door).You cannot have call task expiry beyond the campaign expiry date.

blocks.raw:
For example,\
Consider a call task campaign with a start date and execution date is April 20, 2021, and an end date is April 25, 2021.
blocks.text: For example,Consider a call task campaign with a start date and execution date is April 20, 2021, and an end date is April 25, 2021.

blocks.raw: ### For one time campaign
blocks.text: For one time campaign

blocks.raw:
* If the call task expiry is set to 3 days, the message will disappear on InStore/Store2Door after 3 days from the execution date - April 23, 2021.
* If the call task expiry is set to 7 days, the message will disappear along with the campaign expiry - April 25, 2021.

blocks.raw:
* The message that triggers on April 20,  will be available until Apr 23 (end).
* The message that triggers on April 21,  will be available on Apr 24 (end).
* The message that triggers on April 22,  will be available on Apr 25 (end).
* The message that triggers on April 23, 24, and 25 will also disappear on Apr 25 (end).

blocks.raw: ## Store to perform call task
blocks.text: Store to perform call task

blocks.raw: You can assign call tasks to the store where the customer is registered or last purchased.

blocks.raw: ### Call task status
blocks.text: Call task status

blocks.raw: To configure the call task status, follow these steps.
blocks.text: To configure the call task status, follow these steps.

blocks.raw:
1. Enable the task status(**Open**, **Closed**, and **InProgress**) using the checkbox. Enabled options will appear to store staff for updating the task progress.
2. Select the default status using the drop-down option.

blocks.raw: ## Create custom labels for call tasks
blocks.text: Create custom labels for call tasks

blocks.raw: You can create custom labels for each call task status. These labels will show up as statuses in Call Task campaigns.
blocks.text: You can create custom labels for each call task status. These labels will show up as statuses in Call Task campaigns.

blocks.raw: To create a custom label for a call task status, follow these steps.
blocks.text: To create a custom label for a call task status, follow these steps.

blocks.raw: 1. On the Engage+ home page, click on the **setting** icon and navigate to the **Call task** page.
blocks.text: On the Engage+ home page, click on the setting icon and navigate to the Call task page.
